content.text: Amanda SiposI only hope that Adrian Brody will have finished his brief speech by then.33Sanjay ChurmureOscar goes too..overall score, oscar goes too TRUE subject, off course best actor, best picture, best actress, best screen play oscar goes too..one hand to other hand one heart to other heart one thought to other thought oscar goes too...Deborah GeorgeWill not be watching the streaming so……so long!Jesus ParedesActriz Y Belleza MujerChantal Baudaux Liliana Morillo Verónica SchneiderJesus ParedesActor Y Bello Hombre Tom Cruise Brad Pitt 98 TH Oscars 2026Roberta VernonSo, what’s the point of these awards if those who vote on them aren’t required to watch every nominated movie?How do you say one movie, or one actor is the best, when you haven’t seen them all?Robinson AlmanzarWho really needs to mark your award show in a calendar 10 and half months away??!! If you want people to be excited about one of the most boring, long and overrated award shows in tv then work on making it better….الناقد - خالد محمودOf course, I will pay great attention to this great occasion, and I hope that the awards will go to the cinema that I love, that is artistically strong and inspiring, and that is far from any political ideologies.
